text: A sample of 301 SMI patients (bipolar disorder or schizophrenia) and 200 controls was first split into a training ( N = 401) and testing dataset ( N = 100). A logistic regression using ERG was modeled in the training data, while external validation and discriminative ability were assessed in the testing data. A decision curve analysis was used to test clinical usefulness. Moreover, the identification of thresholds of uncertainty based on the two-graph ROC and the interval of uncertainty was used to enhance prediction.
source_label: Developing a clinical decision tool based on electroretinogram to monitor the risk of severe mental illness
